content:
lena: Quick heads-up — perfetto capture from today's dedicated run shows very sparse line info for runtime binaries. GPU kernels are there but functions are just addresses. Trace taken inside alpine-based container (musl) on ded-03.
Samir: did you build with debug info? CMAKE was RelWithDebInfo right?
lena: yes, CI uses RelWithDebInfo but we run a strip step in the final image: strip --strip-unneeded build/libredwood_runtime.so in Dockerfile.
joel: strip will remove symbols. But build-id should still map to debuginfo files unless the container can't find them.
lena: agree — the host has /usr/lib/debug with .debug files but container image is tiny. perfetto shows addresses and buildid hex but no file/line.
perf-bot: perfetto-collector: trace saved -> /traces/perfetto-1887654321.pb
maria: try checking the ELF notes and build-id inside the container: run `readelf -n build/libredwood_runtime.so`
lena: ran it — output has Build ID: 1f2d3c4b... but readelf on the host has same id. addr2line inside container returns '??:0'
samir: sounds like addr2line can't find the debug file. Two options: ship .debug into image OR mount host debug dir at runtime.
joel: also watch out for musl vs glibc differences — some tools assume glibc paths for build-id cache. That's tricky with Alpine.
lena: quick test: mounted host /usr/lib/debug into container -> restarted trace -> perfetto timeline now shows function names! :tada:
lena: command used:
```
docker run --rm -v /usr/lib/debug:/usr/lib/debug -it my-image /bin/sh
```
samir: nice. For prod we should automate either embedding debug packages in debug image variant OR map PERF_BUILDID_DIR at startup.
joel: FYI CUPTI can also hide line info for certain GPU annotations if the app uses nvtx wrappers built without debug. Not the main issue here but keep in mind.
maria: we should add a CI job to produce a debuginfo tarball per build and upload to s3 with build-id index.
lena: opened a tracking ticket: infra#1245 to push debuginfo artifacts and add an optional runtime mount flag. Also adding note to docs about musl/alpine caveat.
samir: for now, add a short-run on canary nodes that mounts debug dir and collect an nsys/nsight capture to confirm no regressions.
lena: done — I'll attach sample perfetto pb and nsys output to the ticket.
joel: thanks. follow up: check container build pipeline for any 'strip' in later layers — sometimes CI strips during packaging step.
lena: yep saw that, changing packaging to keep .dbg files in a separate artifact. Closing thread once ticket lands. :white_check_mark:
